description: Scan HTML or text you already have (an email, a document, a tool result, a page fetched elsewhere) for prompt injection before it reaches your prompt. To fetch a URL, use read_url instead; for MCP tool definitions or skill files, use audit_mcp_server or audit_agent_skill. Returns risk (0-1), level (low/medium/high), findings (type, snippet, position, confidence), clean_text and wrapped_text, which marks the rest as untrusted data. Costs US$0.002 in USDC on Base (x402). Max 256 KB.

content.description: The HTML or text to scan (max 256 KB)

format.description: How to parse content: html (default) also strips hidden elements, comments and styles; use text for plain text such as an email body

return_text.description: Include clean_text and wrapped_text (default true); false returns only the report, which is smaller

url.description: Where the content came from (optional); used to resolve relative links in HTML

name: check_prompt_injection
title: Scan content for prompt injection
